verdict.rationale: The evidence shows transaction monitoring workflows that generate alerts or investigations (alloy-docs-17), plus a homepage claim of 'agentic automation' for KYC/AML/fraud checks (alloy-docs-20). Nothing documents an in-product agent that investigates transaction alerts or drafts review notes. Generic agentic automation of checks is an adjacent capability, not the named one.

support.subject: As a ai-native, I can use an in-product agent to investigate transaction alerts and prepare review notes
